about_the_game:
Design Your Own Cemetery:

Buy and restore a ruined cemetery, then expand it; add services like toilets and guest houses for visitors through cleaning, decoration, and landscaping. Repair old gravestones and add mausoleums and statues to offer elite clients a magnificent space. Gain prestige and become the country’s most elite cemetery.

Prepare Funerals:

 Take newly deceased individuals to the morgue, wash, and clean them. Organize the memorial service in the church. Apply makeup to make the deceased’s face look lively, and carefully dress them in the finest clothes. These preparations are crucial; help them present themselves for the last time in the most beautiful way possible in front of their loved ones!

Choose Different Burial Methods:

 The game features various religions and burial traditions. The deceased’s family’s wishes regarding burial or cremation must be carried out with precision. Players will discover the challenges and rewards of each method while managing their cemetery. This variety offers different experiences with each playthrough, enhancing the game's replayability.

Interaction with Visitors and Moral Dilemmas:

 Graveyard Simulator focuses on interactions with NPCs as well as cemetery management. Players will face conscientious and moral dilemmas through dialogues, feeling the responsibility of not only being a manager but also a decision-maker.

Optional Third-Person Mode:

 The game’s primary camera is in first-person (FPS) perspective, but players can optionally activate the third-person (TPS) camera mode to personalize their experience.

Optional VR Support:

 Graveyard Simulator offers a deeper experience with VR support. The VR Mode is an additional mode included in the main game. Players can experience cemetery management and interactions with visitors firsthand in VR mode.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu ses kartı
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2,Meta Quest Pro,Oculus Rift S,Valve Index
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 veya Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu ses kartı
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2,Meta Quest Pro,Oculus Rift S,Valve Index
  • Additional Notes: SSD önerilir, hızlı yükleme süreleri için.

short_description: Graveyard Simulator is a simulation game focused on strategy, design, and moral choices as you transform an abandoned cemetery into a prestigious memorial site. Take on daily graveyard tasks and delve deep into humanity’s relationship with death.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Czech, Spanish - Spain, Polish
*languages with full audio support
